accessibility.meta.title: Accessibility Statement | OUT
accessibility.meta.description: OUT’s accessibility statement: conformance status with Israeli Standard SI 5568 / WCAG 2.x at level AA, the accessibility coordinator’s details, and ways to contact us.
accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.commitment.title: Our commitment
accessibility.commitment.body: At OUT, we believe that training outdoors should be accessible to everyone. We are working to make the OUT app and website accessible to people with disabilities, as part of our commitment to health that is accessible to everyone.
accessibility.standard.title: The standard and current status
accessibility.standard.body: We are adapting the service to Israeli Standard SI 5568 (based on WCAG 2.x) at level AA, in accordance with the Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities (Service Accessibility Adjustments) Regulations.
accessibility.standard.status: Status: conformance in progress. The service does not yet fully meet the requirements of the standard. We review the screens systematically, fix deficiencies in order of importance, and update this statement as conformance progresses. Until it is complete, some screens and components may not yet be fully accessible.
accessibility.standard.toolbar: In addition, a third-party accessibility toolbar (UserWay) is available to enable in the app settings, under “Enable accessibility toolbar”. The toolbar is off by default and is not loaded until you enable it. It is a supplementary aid and does not replace the adjustments we make in the code.
accessibility.done.title: What has already been adjusted
accessibility.done.iconButtons: Buttons marked with an icon only have been given an accessible name for screen readers.
accessibility.done.contrast: Text and icon colors in the brand blue were darkened to meet a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1.
accessibility.done.intervalLabel: The intervals label on the workout screen is displayed on an opaque background, so that the contrast does not depend on the content behind it.
accessibility.adjust.title: Adjustments in the app
accessibility.adjust.rtl: The app is set to the correct language and direction (Hebrew, right to left).
accessibility.adjust.zoom: The display can be enlarged (zoom) on any device, including pinching on a touch screen.
accessibility.adjust.reducedMotion: When the device is set to a reduced motion preference, some animations are reduced.
accessibility.adjust.altText: Images with content have alternative text, and decorative images are hidden from screen readers.
accessibility.limits.title: Known limitations
accessibility.limits.intro: We are aware of the following limitations and are working to fix them:
accessibility.limits.maps: The maps in the app are not fully accessible to keyboards and screen readers. The information on them is also available by contacting us.
accessibility.limits.videos: The instructional and exercise videos do not currently include captions.
accessibility.contact.title: Accessibility coordinator and contacting us
accessibility.contact.intro: Did you encounter a difficulty, or do you need the information in another way? We will be glad to hear from you and to handle your request.
accessibility.contact.tips: When contacting us, we recommend stating the screen or action, the device or browser, and the assistive technology you used (if any). We will try to reply as soon as possible.
privacy.meta.title: Privacy Policy | OUT
privacy.meta.description: OUT’s privacy policy: how we collect, use, and protect your information, including Apple HealthKit and Google Health Connect data.
privacy.health.badge: Compliant with Google Play Health Connect and Apple HealthKit requirements

termsDoc.title: Terms of Use
termsDoc.intro.p1: Calisthenics Ltd., Company No. 516841806 | Version 2.1 | April 2026 | office@appout.co.il
termsDoc.s1.title: 1. General
termsDoc.s1.p1: The OUT app is operated by Calisthenics Ltd., Company No. 516841806 (hereinafter: the “Company”). The app provides physical activity tracking services, personalized training programs, mapping of public fitness facilities, and the creation of physical activity communities.
termsDoc.s1.p2: Use of the app is conditional upon full acceptance of these Terms of Use and the Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, you are not permitted to use the app. Any user who uses the app shall be deemed to have agreed to all of the terms.
termsDoc.s1.p3: The Privacy Policy forms an integral part of these Terms of Use.
termsDoc.s1.p4: The Company reserves the right to change these terms from time to time. Material changes will be published in the app at least 30 days before they take effect. Continued use after publication constitutes agreement to the updated terms.
termsDoc.s2.title: 2. Eligibility
termsDoc.s2.p1: The app is intended only for users aged 14 and over. Users under the age of 14 are not permitted to register or to use the app, and any attempt to register will be blocked automatically.
termsDoc.s2.p2: Users aged 14–17 are defined as “minors”, and additional usage restrictions shall apply to them, including restrictions on private conversations and social content.
termsDoc.s2.p3: The user declares that they meet the age requirements and all other eligibility requirements. The Company reserves the right to cancel an account opened in contravention of these age requirements.
termsDoc.s3.title: 3. Health Declaration and Physical Responsibility
termsDoc.s3.p1: As a condition of using the app, every user shall complete a medical questionnaire and sign a health declaration in accordance with the Fitness Centers Law (Licensing and Supervision), Amendment No. 2, 5775-2015. The Company may refuse to allow use by a user who does not meet the required health conditions.
termsDoc.s3.p2: The app is not a substitute for professional medical advice. The Company recommends consulting a doctor before starting any physical activity, especially for people with existing health problems.
termsDoc.s3.p3: Use of public fitness facilities is at the user’s sole responsibility, in accordance with the instructions displayed at each facility and the signs in the park.
termsDoc.s4.title: 4. Subscriptions and Payments
termsDoc.s4.u1.title: 4.1 Purchase and billing
termsDoc.s4.u1.p1: The app includes free services and paid services. Payment for premium services is made through the Apple App Store or the Google Play Store. Prices and billing terms are clearly displayed before the purchase is made.
termsDoc.s4.u1.p2: The subscription renews automatically at the end of each period, unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period.
termsDoc.s4.u1.p3: No refund will be given for a subscription period that has begun, except in exceptional circumstances and subject to Apple/Google policy.
termsDoc.s4.u2.title: 4.2 Canceling a subscription
termsDoc.s4.u2.p1: A subscription is canceled through the Apple ID settings (iOS) or Google Play (Android). Access to premium services is retained until the end of the paid subscription period.
termsDoc.s5.title: 5. Virtual Coins
termsDoc.s5.p1: The app includes a system of points and credits (hereinafter: “coins”) awarded to users for completing workouts and meeting goals.
termsDoc.s5.p2: The coins are virtual only and have no monetary value outside the app.
termsDoc.s5.p3: It is not possible to purchase coins with real money.
termsDoc.s5.p4: It is not possible to convert coins into cash, credit, a voucher, or any benefit outside the app.
termsDoc.s5.p5: The coins are not transferable between users.
termsDoc.s5.p6: Upon deletion of an account, the coins are deleted and cannot be restored.
termsDoc.s5.p7: The Company reserves the right to change, reset, or cancel coins that were accumulated improperly.
termsDoc.s6.title: 6. Copyright and Intellectual Property
termsDoc.s6.p1: All intellectual property rights in the app, including training programs, explanatory videos, texts, images, graphics, the user interface, and trademarks, belong to the Company and are protected by law.
termsDoc.s6.p2: It is strictly prohibited to copy, reproduce, modify, distribute, publish, create derivative works from, or sell this content without the express written permission of the Company.
termsDoc.s6.p3: Certain instructional videos are stored and served through an external CDN service (Bunny.net). All rights are reserved to the Company.
termsDoc.s7.title: 7. User-Generated Content (UGC)
termsDoc.s7.u1.title: 7.1 Publishing content
termsDoc.s7.u1.p1: The user may publish posts and comments in the community feed. The user is solely responsible for the content they publish and declares that they hold the rights to publish it.
termsDoc.s7.u2.title: 7.2 Prohibited content
termsDoc.s7.u2.p1: It is strictly prohibited to upload content that is offensive, threatening, racist, sexual, harassing, or unlawful.
termsDoc.s7.u2.p2: It is prohibited to impersonate another person or entity.
termsDoc.s7.u2.p3: It is prohibited to upload content that infringes the copyright or intellectual property of a third party.
termsDoc.s7.u2.p4: It is prohibited to upload content containing viruses, malware, or links to harmful websites.
termsDoc.s7.u3.title: 7.3 Deleting content
termsDoc.s7.u3.p1: The user may delete posts they published at any time. The Company reserves the right to remove any content that violates the Terms of Use, within 24 hours of receiving a report.
termsDoc.s7.u4.title: 7.4 Reporting offensive content
termsDoc.s7.u4.p1: A user who identifies offensive content is invited to report it through the report button in the app. The Company undertakes to review every report and to act accordingly within 24 hours.
termsDoc.s8.title: 8. Rules of Conduct
termsDoc.s8.p1: The user undertakes to use the app in good faith and in accordance with the law.
termsDoc.s8.p2: The user undertakes not to attempt to hack, disrupt, or harm the operation of the app.
termsDoc.s8.p3: The user undertakes not to collect information about other users without their consent.
termsDoc.s8.p4: The user undertakes not to make commercial use of the app’s content without written approval.
termsDoc.s8.p5: The user undertakes not to falsify workout data or points.
termsDoc.s8.p6: The user undertakes not to create multiple accounts for the same user.
termsDoc.s8.p7: The Company reserves the right to block access, revoke permissions, and remove content at any time, in particular in cases of violation of the Terms of Use.
termsDoc.s9.title: 9. Social Features
termsDoc.s9.u1.title: 9.1 Private conversations
termsDoc.s9.u1.p1: The app enables private conversations (DM) between adult users (18+). Minor users are not permitted to hold private conversations with users outside their organizational tenant.
termsDoc.s9.u2.title: 9.2 Location sharing
termsDoc.s9.u2.p1: Sharing location on the community map is optional and takes place solely with the user’s consent. The location of minors is always blurred, and minors and adults are separated on the map.
termsDoc.s9.u3.title: 9.3 Followers and connections
termsDoc.s9.u3.p1: The user’s profile does not appear in search by default. The user can enable profile visibility through the privacy settings.
termsDoc.s10.title: 10. Access to the Camera and Gallery
termsDoc.s10.p1: The app may request access to the device’s camera and photo gallery for the following purposes only: uploading a personal profile picture and sharing workout photos in the community feed.
termsDoc.s10.p2: Access takes place solely after the user’s express approval through the operating system’s dialog box. The user may revoke this access at any time through the device settings.
termsDoc.s10.p3: The app does not scan, collect, or analyze other images in the gallery. Images that the user chose to upload are stored securely in Firebase Storage and are not shared with advertising companies or external parties.
termsDoc.s10.p4: The app does not request access to the microphone.
termsDoc.s11.title: 11. Links to External Websites
termsDoc.s11.p1: The app may include links to external websites. The Company is not responsible for the content of these websites. The inclusion of a link does not constitute an endorsement by the Company.
termsDoc.s12.title: 12. Limitation of Liability
termsDoc.s12.p1: The app is provided for use “as is” (AS IS). The Company shall not be liable for direct, indirect, physical, or other damages arising from the use of the app, including damages arising from performing physical exercises.
termsDoc.s12.p2: The Company’s total financial liability shall not exceed the consideration paid by the user in the 6 months preceding the event.
termsDoc.s12.p3: No claims may be brought against the Company after 12 months from the event.
termsDoc.s13.title: 13. Governing Law and Jurisdiction
termsDoc.s13.p1: These Terms of Use are governed by the laws of the State of Israel. The competent courts in Tel Aviv-Yafo shall have exclusive jurisdiction.
termsDoc.s14.title: 14. General Provisions
termsDoc.s14.p1: These Terms of Use, together with the Privacy Policy, constitute the entire set of applicable provisions. A waiver of a right is not a permanent waiver. If any provision is found to be invalid, the validity of the remaining provisions shall not be affected.
termsDoc.s14.p2: The Company may assign its rights to another entity, provided that such entity undertakes to act in accordance with these Terms of Use.
termsDoc.s14.p3: This document entered into effect on 1 January 2026. © 2026 Calisthenics Ltd. All rights reserved.
privacyDoc.title: Privacy Policy
privacyDoc.intro.p1: Calisthenics Ltd., Company No. 516841806 | Version 2.3 | October 2026 | office@appout.co.il
privacyDoc.s1.title: Introduction
privacyDoc.s1.p1: Calisthenics Ltd. is committed to protecting the privacy of OUT users. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and how we protect it.
privacyDoc.s1.p2: This policy complies with the requirements of: the Privacy Protection Law (Israel), the Privacy Protection (Data Security) Regulations, 5777-2017, the GDPR (European Union), the Apple App Store Review Guidelines, and the Google Play Developer Program Policies.
privacyDoc.s2.title: 1. Information We Collect
privacyDoc.s2.u1.title: 1.1 Information the user provides directly
privacyDoc.s2.u1.p1: Registration details: first name, gender, date of birth.
privacyDoc.s2.u1.p2: Contact details: email address (optional, solely for account backup).
privacyDoc.s2.u1.p3: Fitness information: height, weight, fitness level, available equipment, preferred training days and times.
privacyDoc.s2.u1.p4: Health declaration: answers to the PAR-Q+ questionnaire (13 medical questions). Stored securely and separately. Not shared with third parties.
privacyDoc.s2.u1.p5: User-generated content: posts, comments, and images that the user uploads voluntarily.
privacyDoc.s2.u2.title: 1.2 Physical activity information
privacyDoc.s2.u2.p1: Workout data: workout type, duration, intensity, exercises performed, credits accumulated.
privacyDoc.s2.u2.p2: Running data: full GPS route, pace, distance, time. Collected only while an active run is being recorded and requires the user’s express location permission.
privacyDoc.s2.u2.p3: Progress level: score, level, workout streak, achievements.
privacyDoc.s2.u3.title: 1.3 Location information
privacyDoc.s2.u3.p1: Approximate location: collected in order to display nearby parks and communities. Requires express permission.
privacyDoc.s2.u3.p2: Location during a workout: blurred (~100 meters) before saving. Precise location is saved only in running routes that the user chose to record.
privacyDoc.s2.u3.p3: Location of minors: always blurred to a higher degree. Minors and adults are separated on the map.
privacyDoc.s2.u4.title: 1.4 Technical information
privacyDoc.s2.u4.p2: App version, operating system, device type.
privacyDoc.s2.u4.p3: Anonymous usage data for the purpose of improving the app only (can be disabled).
privacyDoc.s3.title: 2. Health Data: Apple HealthKit and Google Health Connect
privacyDoc.s3.u1.title: 2.1 What is read
privacyDoc.s3.u1.p1: Daily step count, minutes of physical activity.
privacyDoc.s3.u1.p2: Running and workout data performed through the app.
privacyDoc.s3.u1.p3: The app does not read calorie data from HealthKit or from Health Connect. The calories displayed are calculated within the app on the basis of the workout performed, and are written back to the device’s health system.
privacyDoc.s3.u2.title: 2.2 What is written
privacyDoc.s3.u2.p1: Workout data performed through OUT (type, duration, calories).
privacyDoc.s3.u2.p2: Running data recorded through the app.
privacyDoc.s3.u3.title: 2.3 Absolute commitments
privacyDoc.s3.u3.p1: Health data is collected solely with the user’s express permission.
privacyDoc.s3.u3.p2: Health data is used solely to display personal data to the user and to track the user’s progress.
privacyDoc.s3.u3.p3: We do not transfer health data to third parties, including advertising providers, insurance companies, employers, or any other party.
privacyDoc.s3.u3.p4: We do not use health data for advertising, marketing, credit scoring, or any purpose other than personal tracking.
privacyDoc.s3.u3.p5: Health data will never be used to determine eligibility for insurance, to make employment decisions, for credit rating, or for housing, and will not be sold to data brokers or to any other commercial party, without any exception.
privacyDoc.s3.u3.p6: The data values from HealthKit / Health Connect, namely step count and activity duration, are not stored on OUT’s servers, and are displayed in real time from the device.
privacyDoc.s3.u3.p7: In order to prevent duplicates, a technical identifier of each record that was read is stored, without the value itself and without the date of the activity.
privacyDoc.s3.u3.p8: Accumulated activity totals, for example the total weekly activity minutes, are stored in your account in order to show you your progress over time.
privacyDoc.s3.u3.p9: All of this data is deleted completely upon deletion of the account.
privacyDoc.s3.u3.p10: The user can revoke access at any time through the phone settings.
privacyDoc.s4.title: 3. How We Use Information
privacyDoc.s4.p1: Displaying personal activity data to the user.
privacyDoc.s4.p2: Operating training programs and adapting them to the user’s level.
privacyDoc.s4.p3: Improving the app on the basis of anonymous usage patterns (can be disabled).
privacyDoc.s4.p4: Sending Push notifications for workout reminders and updates, in accordance with the user’s preferences and subject to the user’s approval.
privacyDoc.s4.p5: Keeping in touch on matters related to the service (updates, changes to the terms).
privacyDoc.s4.p6: Direct marketing, solely to users who have given express consent, with a simple option to opt out at any time.
privacyDoc.s5.title: 4. Device Permissions
privacyDoc.s5.p1: Location (while using the app): displaying nearby parks, tracking running routes, connecting to local communities. Optional.
privacyDoc.s5.p2: Push notifications: workout reminders, achievements, community updates, marketing messages (with consent). Optional.
privacyDoc.s5.p3: HealthKit / Health Connect: reading steps and physical activity, writing workout data. Optional.
privacyDoc.s5.p4: Camera and gallery: uploading a profile picture and sharing workout photos only. Access only with express permission. The app does not scan other images in the gallery and does not share images with advertising parties. Optional.
privacyDoc.s5.p5: The app does not request access to the microphone.
privacyDoc.s6.title: 5. Third-Party Services and Data Sharing
privacyDoc.s6.p1: The Company does not sell, lease, or trade users’ personal information. Health data will not be shared with any third party, without exception.
privacyDoc.s6.u1.title: 5.1 Technology service providers
privacyDoc.s6.u1.p1: Firebase / Google Cloud: data storage, authentication, Cloud Functions. User data is encrypted. Servers in the USA and/or the European Union.
privacyDoc.s6.u1.p2: Firebase Analytics (Google): anonymous usage analysis. Can be disabled.
privacyDoc.s6.u1.p3: Firebase Auth (Google): user authentication. Email, UID identifier.
privacyDoc.s6.u1.p4: Mapbox: maps, navigation, geocoding. GPS coordinates for the purpose of the map and routes.
privacyDoc.s6.u1.p5: reCAPTCHA Enterprise (Google): security against bots (App Check). Device fingerprint and interaction signals.
privacyDoc.s6.u1.p6: Bunny.net: CDN for instructional videos (admin only). Video files only. No PII of end users.
privacyDoc.s6.u1.p7: FCM (Firebase Cloud Messaging): sending Push notifications. Device token only. No personal content.
privacyDoc.s6.u1.p8: Anthropic: the AI provider for the personal training features, only when these features are used (see 5.3).
privacyDoc.s6.u2.title: 5.3 Artificial intelligence (AI) features
privacyDoc.s6.u2.p1: When AI features in the app are used (for example, a personal coach note), a limited summary of your training data is sent to the AI provider, Anthropic: goals, levels, recent workouts, and a general area (a city or neighborhood, not a precise location), solely for the purpose of generating personal training text.
privacyDoc.s6.u2.p2: Contact details (email, phone), full name, the health declaration, and raw values from Apple HealthKit / Google Health Connect are not sent.
privacyDoc.s6.u2.p3: Under Anthropic’s commercial terms, information sent to it in business use is not used to train models by default. Anthropic may retain it for a limited period for security and abuse-prevention purposes, and its processing may take place in the USA.
privacyDoc.s6.u2.p4: The AI features are available to adult users only.
privacyDoc.s6.u3.title: 5.2 Sharing data with local authorities and public authorities
privacyDoc.s6.u3.p1: The OUT app may share with partner local authorities and public sports authorities only anonymous and aggregated statistical data, for example: general load on public facilities, total workout volume in geographic areas, and peak hours of park use. This information is used solely for the purpose of improving public sports infrastructure.
privacyDoc.s6.u3.p2: This data is completely anonymous, aggregated, and cannot be linked to any individual user (Non-PII Aggregated Data). It contains no name, identifier, IP address, precise location, or any other identifying detail.
privacyDoc.s6.u3.p3: Personally identifiable information (PII), including name, email, date of birth, health profile, and any data that can be linked to a user, will not be shared, transferred, or sold to local authorities, to government authorities, or to any other party.
privacyDoc.s6.u3.p4: Raw health data from Apple HealthKit or Google Health Connect sources, including steps, calories, and activity minutes, will not be shared, transferred, or sold to local authorities, to third parties, to advertising providers, to insurance companies, to employers, or to any other party, without any exception.
privacyDoc.s7.title: 6. Data Storage and Server Location
privacyDoc.s7.p1: All personal information is stored securely on Google Cloud / Firebase servers. The information is encrypted both in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256 by Google Cloud KMS).
privacyDoc.s7.p2: Cloud Functions servers are located in us-central1 (USA), which means that users’ data may be processed in the United States. This processing is carried out in accordance with Google Cloud’s privacy policy and complies with GDPR standards.
privacyDoc.s7.p3: Automatic daily backups are encrypted and stored separately.
privacyDoc.s7.p4: The values of the health data from HealthKit / Health Connect are not stored on our servers. Only record identifiers, for the purpose of preventing duplication, and accumulated activity totals are stored, at the same level of encryption as other personal information.
privacyDoc.s7.p5: Health declarations (PDF) are stored in Firebase Storage with full encryption, with access limited to the owner and the admin only.
privacyDoc.s8.title: 7. Push Notifications
privacyDoc.s8.p1: The app sends Push notifications after receiving express permission from the user.
privacyDoc.s8.p2: Business notifications (reminders, achievements) are sent in accordance with the user’s settings.
privacyDoc.s8.p3: Marketing notifications are sent solely to users who have given separate express consent.
privacyDoc.s8.p4: All notifications can be disabled at any time through the device settings or the app settings.
privacyDoc.s8.p5: The device token (FCM Token) is used solely for sending notifications and is not shared with third parties.
privacyDoc.s9.title: 8. User Rights
privacyDoc.s9.u1.title: 8.1 Access and correction
privacyDoc.s9.u1.p1: The user can view and update their personal details at any time through the profile settings in the app.
privacyDoc.s9.u2.title: 8.2 Deleting an account
privacyDoc.s9.u2.p1: The user may delete their account and all of their personal information at any time, directly from within the app: Settings → Account → Delete account.
privacyDoc.s9.u2.p2: After confirmation, an automatic deletion process begins, which includes: deletion of profile details, workout history, location data, social connections, and health images from cloud storage.
privacyDoc.s9.u2.p3: Posts published in the community feed will be anonymized (the author will be replaced with “Deleted user”) and will not be deleted, in order to preserve the integrity of community conversations.
privacyDoc.s9.u2.p4: The deletion process is completed within 24 hours. Audit logs are retained for 24 months for security purposes.
privacyDoc.s9.u2.p5: Retention for legal defense (Legal Hold): in accordance with the Israeli Statute of Limitations Law (5718-1958, limitation period of 7 years), some of the data will be retained after the account is deleted, for legal defense purposes only. The data retained: name, email address, workout history (including GPS routes), park reviews, and the health declaration (PAR-Q). This data is stored separately and securely, is not accessible to the user or to any unauthorized party, is used solely for legal defense in the event of a claim, and is deleted automatically at the end of 7 years from the date the account was deleted.
privacyDoc.s9.u2.p6: Alternatively: sending a written deletion request to office@appout.co.il or through the form at https://out-run-app.vercel.app/delete-data. Deletion will be carried out within 15 days.
privacyDoc.s9.u3.title: 8.3 Withdrawing consents
privacyDoc.s9.u3.p1: Opting out of direct marketing: through the app settings → Notifications → Marketing, or by contacting office@appout.co.il. Within 5 business days.
privacyDoc.s9.u3.p2: Disabling Firebase Analytics: Settings → Privacy → Opt out of sharing anonymous data.
privacyDoc.s9.u4.title: 8.4 Data deletion request from the web
privacyDoc.s9.u4.p1: Users who have removed the app from the device can submit a data deletion request through the online form: https://out-run-app.vercel.app/delete-data
privacyDoc.s9.u4.p2: The form is available to anyone and does not require logging in to the app. Requests received will be handled within 15 days.
privacyDoc.s10.title: 9. Private Conversations (Chat)
privacyDoc.s10.p1: Messages in private conversations are encrypted with Firebase encryption (encryption at rest and in transit), but are not end-to-end encrypted.
privacyDoc.s10.p2: Minors under the age of 18 cannot hold private conversations with users outside their organization.
privacyDoc.s11.title: 10. Privacy of Minors
privacyDoc.s11.p1: The app is not intended for children under the age of 14. Access is blocked automatically.
privacyDoc.s11.p2: Minors aged 14–17 are subject to additional restrictions: increased location blurring, separation from adults on the map, and restriction of private conversations.
privacyDoc.s11.p3: If we learn that information was collected from a minor under the age of 14 without parental consent, we will delete the information immediately.
privacyDoc.s12.title: 11. Data Retention Policy
privacyDoc.s12.p1: Profile and workout details: until the account is deleted, and then deletion within 24 hours.
privacyDoc.s12.p2: Health declaration (PDF): until the account is deleted.
privacyDoc.s12.p3: Health Connect / HealthKit data: the data values are not stored at all. Record identifiers and accumulated activity totals are stored until the account is deleted, and then deleted within 24 hours. Upon revocation of permission, reading from the device stops immediately.
privacyDoc.s12.p4: Posts in the feed: anonymized after the account is deleted.
privacyDoc.s12.p5: Chat messages: anonymized after the account is deleted.
privacyDoc.s12.p6: Location data (presence): deleted automatically within 24 hours of inactivity.
privacyDoc.s12.p7: Active workout heartbeat: deleted automatically within 2 hours of the end of a workout.
privacyDoc.s12.p8: Audit Logs: 24 months (retained for security purposes even after the account is deleted).
privacyDoc.s12.p9: Push notifications sent: deleted automatically after 90 days.
privacyDoc.s12.p10: Legal archive (Legal Hold): name, email address, workout history (including GPS routes), park reviews, and health declaration, retained for 7 years from the date the account was deleted, by virtue of the Israeli Statute of Limitations Law (5718-1958). This data is not used for any purpose other than legal defense, and is deleted automatically at the end of the period.
privacyDoc.s13.title: 12. Information Security
privacyDoc.s13.p1: Encryption in transit: TLS 1.2+ for all communications.
privacyDoc.s13.p2: Encryption at rest: AES-256 by Google Cloud KMS.
privacyDoc.s13.p4: Access control: Firestore Security Rules + Custom Claims JWT.
privacyDoc.s13.p5: App Check: reCAPTCHA Enterprise (browser), DeviceCheck (iOS), Play Integrity (Android).
privacyDoc.s13.p6: Audit logs: every admin action is recorded with IP, timestamp, and before/after content.
privacyDoc.s13.p7: In the event of a material security breach, the Company will notify the affected users within 72 hours.
privacyDoc.s14.title: 13. Changes to the Policy
privacyDoc.s14.p1: Material changes will be published in the app and an update will be sent to registered users at least 30 days before they take effect.
privacyDoc.s15.title: 14. Contact
privacyDoc.s15.p2: Address: 39 Har Zion Boulevard, Tel Aviv
privacyDoc.s15.p3: This policy entered into effect on 1 January 2026. Updated: October 2026 (version 2.3). © 2026 Calisthenics Ltd.

deleteData.meta.description: A request to delete personal data from the OUT app, for users who have removed the app from their device.
deleteData.header.title: Personal data deletion
deleteData.intro.who: This page is intended for users who have removed the OUT app from their device and wish to request deletion of all of their personal data from our servers.
deleteData.intro.inApp: If the app is still installed on your device, you can delete the account directly from within it: Settings → Account → Delete account.
deleteData.cta.label: Submit a deletion request
deleteData.cta.button: Send a deletion request by email
deleteData.cta.subjectNote: The subject “{subject}” will be filled in automatically
deleteData.steps.title: How the process works
deleteData.steps.request.title: Submit a request
deleteData.steps.request.body: Press the button below. Your email app will open with the subject and text already prepared. You only need to add the email address you registered with and send it.
deleteData.steps.verify.title: We verify the request
deleteData.steps.verify.body: We will verify that the email matches an existing account. If necessary, we will contact you for additional details for the purpose of identity verification.
deleteData.steps.erase.title: Deletion within 15 days
deleteData.steps.erase.body: After verification, we will delete all of your personal data: profile, workout history, location data, social connections, and images. You will receive confirmation upon completion.
deleteData.steps.timeline: Requests are handled within 15 days of receipt
deleteData.deleted.title: What is deleted
deleteData.deleted.profile: Profile details (name, age, gender, fitness details)
deleteData.notes.title: For your attention
deleteData.notes.feedPosts: Posts you published in the community feed will be anonymized (your name will be replaced with “Deleted user”) in order to preserve the integrity of conversations.
deleteData.notes.auditLogs: Anonymous audit logs are retained for up to 24 months for security purposes only.
deleteData.notes.subscription: If you have an active premium subscription, deleting the data does not cancel the billing. You must cancel the subscription through the Apple App Store or Google Play before submitting the request.
deleteData.privacyLink.title: Full Privacy Policy
deleteData.privacyLink.body: For details on all the data we collect and how we protect it
credits.meta.title: Licenses and Credits | OUT
credits.meta.description: The data sources and licenses used by OUT: OpenStreetMap, Mapbox, and bike path data from the Ministry of Transport.
credits.title: Licenses and Credits
credits.intro: OUT relies on open data and on the contribution of many people. The sources and their licenses are listed here.
credits.osm.title: OpenStreetMap
credits.osm.body: Trail names, routes, and some of the data on roads and paths in the app come from OpenStreetMap, a free map built by volunteers. The data is distributed under the ODbL 1.0 license (Open Database License).
credits.osm.odblLink: The text of the ODbL 1.0 license
credits.trails.title: Where trail names come from
credits.trails.body: The geometry and names of the marked trails and routes displayed in the app are based on contributions by OpenStreetMap volunteers, under the ODbL 1.0 license.
credits.mapbox.title: Mapbox
credits.mapbox.body: The maps in the app are displayed using Mapbox, and combine data from OpenStreetMap and additional providers. The Mapbox credit appears on the map itself.
credits.transport.title: Ministry of Transport and Road Safety
credits.transport.body: Bike path data originates from the Ministry of Transport and Road Safety, as published in the government data repository data.gov.il under the Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY) license or the “Other (Open)” license, depending on each dataset. The data is displayed with attribution to the source.
